Old heart pine, sanded gently

Three owners painted over this floor. We stripped it by hand around the edges and refinished it amber.

Bare wood reveal

Drum sander at low grit, edger in the corners. Dust catches the window light.

Grain inspection & gap fill

Open pores filled with reclaimed slivers from the same era. No new wood shows.

Amber finish

Two coats of satin polyurethane. The amber stays warm, not yellow.

Price this job

After the nor'easter

Cupped boards along the wall after storm surge. We dried them out over a week, replaced eleven, and the patch is invisible.

  • Moisture reading under the house first
  • Drying timeline: 5–10 days with fans
  • Board replacement matched by age and width

Heart pine restoration
